summary: Completed comprehensive SEO optimization testing. All SEO endpoints (sitemap.xml, robots.txt) are working correctly with proper content. Frontend SEO tags (title, meta description, canonical, OG tags, Twitter cards, JSON-LD structured data) are correctly implemented across all page types. No regressions found in booking, blog, or public SPA functionality.

Backend: GET /api/robots.txt returns text/plain with correct Disallow rules (/admin/, /admin, /sign-in, /sign-up, /book/manage/, /api/) and Sitemap directive
Backend: GET /api/blog/posts returns published posts with all required fields
Backend: GET /api/blog/posts/{slug} returns specific post with body_html, key_takeaways, FAQ, and 404 for non-existent slugs
Backend: All booking endpoints working (create, get slots, manage, reschedule, cancel, reminders cron)
Frontend: Homepage has correct SEO tags (title, description, robots='index, follow', canonical, og:type='website', og:image, twitter:card='summary_large_image', WebSite + Organization JSON-LD)
Frontend: Blog post page has correct SEO tags (robots='index, follow', canonical, og:type='article', og:image from post cover, BlogPosting + BreadcrumbList JSON-LD in @graph)
Frontend: Work detail page has correct SEO tags (robots='index, follow', canonical, og:type='website')
Frontend: Legal page has correct SEO tags (robots='index, follow', canonical)
